title: अष्टाशीतितमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: As Satyaki moves forward Yudhishthira sends his own forces after him, and Drona meets Satyaki in a hard fight. Satyaki breaks through Drona's guard and the Bhoja troops under Kritavarman hold the line.
summary.kn: ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿ ಮುಂದುವರಿದಾಗ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ತನ್ನ ಪಡೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅವನ ಹಿಂದೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ದ್ರೋಣ ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿಯನ್ನು ಕಠಿಣವಾಗಿ ಎದುರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಸಾತ್ಯಕಿ ದ್ರೋಣನ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ ಭೇದಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಕೃತವರ್ಮನ ಭೋಜರು ಸಾಲು ಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: सात्यकि के आगे बढ़ने पर युधिष्ठिर अपनी सेना उसके पीछे भेजते हैं, और द्रोण सात्यकि से कठिन युद्ध करते हैं। सात्यकि द्रोण का रक्षा-घेरा तोड़ता है और कृतवर्मा के भोज योद्धा पंक्ति सँभालते हैं।
summary.te: సాత్యకి ముందుకు సాగగా యుధిష్ఠిరుడు తన బలగాలను అతని వెనుక పంపుతాడు; ద్రోణుడు సాత్యకిని కఠినంగా ఎదుర్కొంటాడు. సాత్యకి ద్రోణుని రక్షణను ఛేదిస్తాడు; కృతవర్మ భోజులు వరుసను నిలుపుతారు.
summary.ta: சாத்யகி முன்னேற, யுதிஷ்டிரர் தம் படைகளை அவன் பின்னால் அனுப்புகிறார்; த்ரோணர் சாத்யகியுடன் கடும்போர் புரிகிறார். சாத்யகி த்ரோணரின் காவலைக் கடக்க, கிருதவர்மனின் போஜர் வரிசையைத் தாங்குகின்றனர்.
summary.ml: സാത്യകി മുന്നോട്ടു നീങ്ങുമ്പോൾ യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ തന്റെ സേനയെ അദ്ദേഹത്തിനുപിന്നാലെ അയയ്ക്കുന്നു; ദ്രോണർ സാത്യകിയെ കഠിനമായി നേരിടുന്നു. ദ്രോണരുടെ കാവൽ ഭേദിച്ച് സാത്യകി കടക്കുന്നു; കൃതവർമാവിന്റെ കീഴിലുള്ള ഭോജസേന നിര പിടിച്ചുനിൽക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.88; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
प्रयाते तव सैन्यं तु युयुधाने युयुत्सया ।
धर्मराजो महाराज स्वेनानीकेन संवृतः ।
प्रायाद्द्रोणरथप्रेप्सुर्युयुधानस्य पृष्ठतः ॥

meaning.en: When Yuyudhana had gone forth against your army, eager to fight, the Dharma king, surrounded by his own troops, followed behind Yuyudhana, hoping to reach Drona's chariot.

verses.text:
ततः पाञ्चालराजस्य पुत्रः समरदुर्मदः ।
प्राक्रोशत्पाण्डवानीके वसुदानश्च पार्थिवः ॥

meaning.en: Then the Panchala king's son, reckless in battle, and King Vasudana cried out in the Pandava army:

verses.text:
आगच्छत प्रहरत द्रुतं विपरिधावत ।
यथा सुखेन गच्छेत सात्यकिर्युद्धदुर्मदः ॥

meaning.en: "Come on, strike, run all around quickly, so that Satyaki, reckless in battle, may go on with ease.

verses.text:
महारथा हि बहवो यतिष्यन्त्यस्य निर्जये ।
इति ब्रुवन्तो वेगेन समापेतुर्बलं तव ॥

meaning.en: Many great chariot-warriors will try to defeat him." Saying this, they fell on your army with speed.

verses.text:
वयं प्रतिजिगीषन्तस्तत्र तान्समभिद्रुताः ।
ततः शब्दो महानासीद्युयुधानरथं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Wishing to repel them, we rushed upon them there, and a great uproar arose around Yuyudhana's chariot.

verses.text:
प्रकम्प्यमाना महती तव पुत्रस्य वाहिनी ।
सात्वतेन महाराज शतधाभिव्यदीर्यत ॥

meaning.en: Shaken by the Satvata, O great king, your son's huge army split into a hundred pieces.

verses.text:
तस्यां विदीर्यमाणायां शिनेः पौत्रो महारथः ।
सप्त वीरान्महेष्वासानग्रानीके व्यपोथयत् ॥

meaning.en: As it broke apart, the great chariot-warrior, grandson of Shini, struck down seven heroic mighty bowmen at the head of the force.

verses.text:
ते भीता मृद्यमानाश्च प्रमृष्टा दीर्घबाहुना ।
आयोधनं जहुर्वीरा दृष्ट्वा तमतिमानुषम् ॥

meaning.en: Terrified, crushed and wiped out by the long-armed one, those heroes left the battlefield on seeing him, superhuman as he was.

verses.text:
रथैर्विमथिताक्षैश्च भग्ननीडैश्च मारिष ।
चक्रैर्विमथितैश्छिन्नैर्ध्वजैश्च विनिपातितैः ॥

meaning.en: With chariots whose axles were shattered, whose seats were broken, whose wheels were crushed and cut, and whose banners were thrown down,

verses.text:
अनुकर्षैः पताकाभिः शिरस्त्राणैः सकाञ्चनैः ।
बाहुभिश्चन्दनादिग्धैः साङ्गदैश्च विशां पते ॥

meaning.en: With dragging-beams, pennants, golden helmets, sandal-smeared arms with armlets, O lord of the people,

verses.text:
हस्तिहस्तोपमैश्चापि भुजगाभोगसंनिभैः ।
ऊरुभिः पृथिवी छन्ना मनुजानां नरोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: And thighs like elephant trunks or coiling snakes, the earth was covered with the bodies of men, O best of men.

verses.text:
शशाङ्कसंनिकाशैश्च वदनैश्चारुकुण्डलैः ।
पतितैर्वृषभाक्षाणां बभौ भारत मेदिनी ॥

meaning.en: Fallen heads like the moon, with lovely earrings and eyes like bulls' eyes, made the earth shine, O Bharata.

verses.text:
गजैश्च बहुधा छिन्नैः शयानैः पर्वतोपमैः ।
रराजातिभृशं भूमिर्विकीर्णैरिव पर्वतैः ॥

meaning.en: With many elephants cut to pieces and lying like mountains, the earth shone as though strewn with mountains.

verses.text:
तपनीयमयैर्योक्त्रैर्मुक्ताजालविभूषितैः ।
उरश्छदैर्विचित्रैश्च व्यशोभन्त तुरंगमाः ।
गतसत्त्वा महीं प्राप्य प्रमृष्टा दीर्घबाहुना ॥

meaning.en: The horses, with golden harness decked with nets of pearls and with various breastplates, looked splendid; lifeless, they lay on the ground, crushed by the long-armed one.

verses.text:
नानाविधानि सैन्यानि तव हत्वा तु सात्वतः ।
प्रविष्टस्तावकं सैन्यं द्रावयित्वा चमूं भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Having slain your many kinds of troops, the Satvata broke your army hard and entered your host.

verses.text:
ततस्तेनैव मार्गेण येन यातो धनंजयः ।
इयेष सात्यकिर्गन्तुं ततो द्रोणेन वारितः ॥

meaning.en: Then Satyaki wished to go by the very path along which Dhananjaya had gone, but Drona stopped him.

verses.text:
भरद्वाजं समासाद्य युयुधानस्तु मारिष ।
नाभ्यवर्तत संक्रुद्धो वेलामिव जलाशयः ॥

meaning.en: Meeting Bharadvaja's son, O king, Yuyudhana, enraged, did not turn back, like the sea that does not cross its shore.

verses.text:
निवार्य तु रणे द्रोणो युयुधानं महारथम् ।
विव्याध निशितैर्बाणैः पञ्चभिर्मर्मभेदिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Having checked the great chariot-warrior Yuyudhana in battle, Drona pierced him with five sharp arrows that tear the vitals.

verses.text:
सात्यकिस्तु रणे द्रोणं राजन्विव्याध सप्तभिः ।
हेमपुङ्खैः शिलाधौतैः कङ्कबर्हिणवाजितैः ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki in turn pierced Drona with seven arrows with golden feathers, washed on stone, fletched with heron and peacock feathers.

verses.text:
तं षड्भिः सायकैर्द्रोणः साश्वयन्तारमार्दयत् ।
स तं न ममृषे द्रोणं युयुधानो महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Drona struck him with six arrows, with his charioteer and horses; the great chariot-warrior Yuyudhana could not bear that from Drona.

verses.text:
सिंहनादं ततः कृत्वा द्रोणं विव्याध सात्यकिः ।
दशभिः सायकैश्चान्यैः षड्भिरष्टाभिरेव च ॥

meaning.en: Roaring a lion's roar, Satyaki then pierced Drona with ten arrows and then others, six and eight.

verses.text:
युयुधानः पुनर्द्रोणं विव्याध दशभिः शरैः ।
एकेन सारथिं चास्य चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान् ।
ध्वजमेकेन बाणेन विव्याध युधि मारिष ॥

meaning.en: Yuyudhana again pierced Drona with ten arrows, his charioteer with one, his four horses with four, and his banner with one arrow in the fight.

verses.text:
तं द्रोणः साश्वयन्तारं सरथध्वजमाशुगैः ।
त्वरन्प्राच्छादयद्बाणैः शलभानामिव व्रजैः ॥

meaning.en: Drona quickly covered him, with his charioteer, chariot and banner, with swift arrows like swarms of locusts.

verses.text:
तथैव युयुधानोऽपि द्रोणं बहुभिराशुगैः ।
प्राच्छादयदसंभ्रान्तस्ततो द्रोण उवाच ह ॥

meaning.en: Likewise Yuyudhana, unflustered, covered Drona with many swift arrows. Then Drona spoke.

verses.text:
तवाचार्यो रणं हित्वा गतः कापुरुषो यथा ।
युध्यमानं हि मां हित्वा प्रदक्षिणमवर्तत ॥

meaning.en: "Your teacher left the battle like a coward and went away; leaving me as I fought, he circled me clockwise.

verses.text:
त्वं हि मे युध्यतो नाद्य जीवन्मोक्ष्यसि माधव ।
यदि मां त्वं रणे हित्वा न यास्याचार्यवद्द्रुतम् ॥

meaning.en: You too, Madhava, will not escape alive from me today as I fight, if you do not leave me quickly as your teacher did."

verses.text: सात्यकिरुवाच

meaning.en: Satyaki said:

verses.text:
धनंजयस्य पदवीं धर्मराजस्य शासनात् ।
गच्छामि स्वस्ति ते ब्रह्मन्न मे कालात्ययो भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: By the Dharma king's order I follow Dhananjaya's path. Good fortune to you, brahmin; I must not lose time.

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
एतावदुक्त्वा शैनेय आचार्यं परिवर्जयन् ।
प्रयातः सहसा राजन्सारथिं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Having said only this, Shaineya, avoiding his teacher, went swiftly on, O king, and said to his charioteer:

verses.text:
द्रोणः करिष्यते यत्नं सर्वथा मम वारणे ।
यत्तो याहि रणे सूत शृणु चेदं वचः परम् ॥

meaning.en: "Drona will try in every way to stop me. Drive on, charioteer, carefully in the fight, and hear this further word.

verses.text:
एतदालोक्यते सैन्यमावन्त्यानां महाप्रभम् ।
अस्यानन्तरतस्त्वेतद्दाक्षिणात्यं महाबलम् ॥

meaning.en: That glorious force you see is of the Avantis; beyond it is the mighty southern force.

verses.text:
तदनन्तरमेतच्च बाह्लिकानां बलं महत् ।
बाह्लिकाभ्याशतो युक्तं कर्णस्यापि महद्बलम् ॥

meaning.en: Next to it is the large army of the Bahlikas, and near the Bahlikas is Karna's great army.

verses.text:
अन्योन्येन हि सैन्यानि भिन्नान्येतानि सारथे ।
अन्योन्यं समुपाश्रित्य न त्यक्ष्यन्ति रणाजिरम् ॥

meaning.en: These armies, charioteer, are broken up by one another, and, leaning on one another, they will not leave the battlefield.

verses.text:
एतदन्तरमासाद्य चोदयाश्वान्प्रहृष्टवत् ।
मध्यमं जवमास्थाय वह मामत्र सारथे ॥

meaning.en: Reaching the gap between them, urge the horses on cheerfully, and, keeping a middle pace, carry me through here, charioteer.

verses.text:
बाह्लिका यत्र दृश्यन्ते नानाप्रहरणोद्यताः ।
दाक्षिणात्याश्च बहवः सूतपुत्रपुरोगमाः ॥

meaning.en: Where the Bahlikas are seen raising various weapons, and many southerners led by the charioteer's son,

verses.text:
हस्त्यश्वरथसंबाधं यच्चानीकं विलोक्यते ।
नानादेशसमुत्थैश्च पदातिभिरधिष्ठितम् ॥

meaning.en: And the force that is seen crowded with elephants, horses and chariots and manned by foot soldiers from many lands."

verses.text:
एतावदुक्त्वा यन्तारं ब्रह्माणं परिवर्जयन् ।
स व्यतीयाय यत्रोग्रं कर्णस्य सुमहद्बलम् ॥

meaning.en: Having said this to his charioteer, and avoiding the brahmin, he passed to where Karna's fierce and very great army stood.

verses.text:
तं द्रोणोऽनुययौ क्रुद्धो विकिरन्विशिखान्बहून् ।
युयुधानं महाबाहुं गच्छन्तमनिवर्तिनम् ॥

meaning.en: Drona, enraged, followed him, scattering many arrows at the mighty-armed Yuyudhana, who went on without turning back.

verses.text:
कर्णस्य सैन्यं सुमहदभिहत्य शितैः शरैः ।
प्राविशद्भारतीं सेनामपर्यन्तां स सात्यकिः ॥

meaning.en: Having smitten Karna's very great army with sharp arrows, Satyaki entered the boundless Bharata army.

verses.text:
प्रविष्टे युयुधाने तु सैनिकेषु द्रुतेषु च ।
अमर्षी कृतवर्मा तु सात्यकिं पर्यवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: When Yuyudhana had entered and the soldiers were fleeing, the wrathful Kritavarman surrounded Satyaki.

verses.text:
तमापतन्तं विशिखैः षड्भिराहत्य सात्यकिः ।
चतुर्भिश्चतुरोऽस्याश्वानाजघानाशु वीर्यवान् ॥

meaning.en: Satyaki, striking him as he came on with six arrows, quickly killed his four horses with four.

verses.text:
ततः पुनः षोडशभिर्नतपर्वभिराशुगैः ।
सात्यकिः कृतवर्माणं प्रत्यविध्यत्स्तनान्तरे ॥

meaning.en: Then Satyaki struck Kritavarman again between the breasts with sixteen swift arrows with straight joints.

verses.text:
स तुद्यमानो विशिखैर्बहुभिस्तिग्मतेजनैः ।
सात्वतेन महाराज कृतवर्मा न चक्षमे ॥

meaning.en: Pierced by many sharp, keen arrows from the Satvata, O great king, Kritavarman could not endure it.

verses.text:
स वत्सदन्तं संधाय जिह्मगानलसंनिभम् ।
आकृष्य राजन्नाकर्णाद्विव्याधोरसि सात्यकिम् ॥

meaning.en: Fitting a vatsadanta arrow, blazing like fire and crooked in flight, and drawing it to his ear, O king, he struck Satyaki in the chest.

verses.text:
स तस्य देहावरणं भित्त्वा देहं च सायकः ।
सपत्रपुङ्खः पृथिवीं विवेश रुधिरोक्षितः ॥

meaning.en: That arrow broke through his armor and his body, and with its feathers and shaft, drenched in blood, it entered the earth.

verses.text:
अथास्य बहुभिर्बाणैरच्छिनत्परमास्त्रवित् ।
समार्गणगुणं राजन्कृतवर्मा शरासनम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Kritavarman, master of the best weapons, cut Satyaki's bow with many arrows, together with its string and arrows, O king.

verses.text:
विव्याध च रणे राजन्सात्यकिं सत्यविक्रमम् ।
दशभिर्विशिखैस्तीक्ष्णैरभिक्रुद्धः स्तनान्तरे ॥

meaning.en: Greatly angered, O king, he struck Satyaki, whose valor is true, between the breasts with ten sharp arrows.

verses.text:
ततः प्रशीर्णे धनुषि शक्त्या शक्तिमतां वरः ।
अभ्यहन्दक्षिणं बाहुं सात्यकिः कृतवर्मणः ॥

meaning.en: Then, his bow shattered, Satyaki, best of those who hold a spear, hurled a spear and struck Kritavarman's right arm.

verses.text:
ततोऽन्यत्सुदृढं वीरो धनुरादाय सात्यकिः ।
व्यसृजद्विशिखांस्तूर्णं शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Then the hero Satyaki took another very strong bow and quickly loosed arrows by the hundred and the thousand.

verses.text:
सरथं कृतवर्माणं समन्तात्पर्यवाकिरत् ।
छादयित्वा रणेऽत्यर्थं हार्दिक्यं तु स सात्यकिः ॥

meaning.en: He covered Hridika's son with his chariot on every side, hiding him greatly in the battle.

verses.text:
अथास्य भल्लेन शिरः सारथेः समकृन्तत ।
स पपात हतः सूतो हार्दिक्यस्य महारथात् ।
ततस्ते यन्तरि हते प्राद्रवंस्तुरगा भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: Then with a broad-headed arrow he cut off the head of Kritavarman's charioteer, who fell dead from the great chariot of Hridika's son; and the horses, their driver killed, bolted wildly.

verses.text:
अथ भोजस्त्वसंभ्रान्तो निगृह्य तुरगान्स्वयम् ।
तस्थौ शरधनुष्पाणिस्तत्सैन्यान्यभ्यपूजयन् ॥

meaning.en: The Bhoja, unflustered, reined in the horses himself and stood with arrows and bow in hand, honoring his own troops.

verses.text:
स मुहूर्तमिवाश्वस्य सदश्वान्समचोदयत् ।
व्यपेतभीरमित्राणामावहत्सुमहद्भयम् ।
सात्यकिश्चाभ्यगात्तस्मात्स तु भीममुपाद्रवत् ॥

meaning.en: After a moment's rest he urged his good horses on, bringing great fear to his enemies who were free of dread, while Satyaki left that place and went on to Bhima.

verses.text:
युयुधानोऽपि राजेन्द्र द्रोणानीकाद्विनिःसृतः ।
प्रययौ त्वरितस्तूर्णं काम्बोजानां महाचमूम् ॥

meaning.en: Yuyudhana too, O king of kings, having emerged from Drona's host, quickly hastened to the great Kamboja army.

verses.text:
स तत्र बहुभिः शूरैः संनिरुद्धो महारथैः ।
न चचाल तदा राजन्सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः ॥

meaning.en: There, hemmed in by many brave great chariot-warriors, Satyaki, whose valor was true, did not waver, O king.

verses.text:
संधाय च चमूं द्रोणो भोजे भारं निवेश्य च ।
अन्वधावद्रणे यत्तो युयुधानं युयुत्सया ॥

meaning.en: Drona, having rallied his force and placed the burden on the Bhoja, followed Yuyudhana in the battle, eager to fight.

verses.text:
तथा तमनुधावन्तं युयुधानस्य पृष्ठतः ।
न्यवारयन्त संक्रुद्धाः पाण्डुसैन्ये बृहत्तमाः ॥

meaning.en: As he pursued Yuyudhana from behind, the greatest warriors in the Pandava army, enraged, held him off.

verses.text:
समासाद्य तु हार्दिक्यं रथानां प्रवरं रथम् ।
पाञ्चाला विगतोत्साहा भीमसेनपुरोगमाः ।
विक्रम्य वारिता राजन्वीरेण कृतवर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: The Panchalas led by Bhimasena, having met Hridika's son, the best of chariot-warriors, lost heart and were checked by the hero Kritavarman's valor.

verses.text:
यतमानांस्तु तान्सर्वानीषद्विगतचेतसः ।
अभितस्ताञ्शरौघेण क्लान्तवाहानवारयत् ॥

meaning.en: Though they were all striving hard, slightly bewildered and with tired horses, he held them back on every side with a flood of arrows.

verses.text:
निगृहीतास्तु भोजेन भोजानीकेप्सवो रणे ।
अतिष्ठन्नार्यवद्वीराः प्रार्थयन्तो महद्यशः ॥

meaning.en: Checked by the Bhoja in the fight, those heroes, wishing to break the Bhoja force, stood like noble men, seeking great fame.
